iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 70. STABLE: Islamabad talks COLLAPSED over 20-year vs 5-year enrichment freeze. Second round delegation heading to Pakistan Tuesday. US/Iran seeking interim memorandum instead of comprehensive deal. IAEA locked out 8+ months. 440kg 60% uranium location unknown. CNN: US/Israel targeting Iran nuclear scientists. NPT Review Conference starts Apr 27. IAEA DG Grossi urges strict verification. Probability 34%. Stable.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 70. RISING: Hormuz RE-CLOSED after brief reopening - Iran says will restrict ships until war definitively ended. Trump: "may not extend ceasefire" if talks fail. Ceasefire expires Apr 22 in 3 DAYS. Oil ~$88 briefly before Hormuz reclosed. US delegation heading to Pakistan Tuesday for second round. Iran denies uranium transfer plan. Iran demands end to US blockade of Iranian ports. IRGC previously fired on tanker Apr 18. Probability 46%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 70. STABLE: 10-day ceasefire mostly holding, expires Apr 26. US-brokered deal signed Apr 16. Israel holding buffer zone 10km inside Lebanon. Hezbollah NOT part of deal - remains armed, demands no Israeli freedom of movement. Trump invites Israel & Lebanon leaders to White House - first high-level talks since 1983. Deal does not require Lebanon to disarm Hezbollah. Israeli drone killed 1 in south Lebanon. In-principle agreement to extend ceasefire reported. Probability 16%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Roketsan opened Europe largest warhead plant (Lalahan), fuel plant, missile integration facilities Apr 7. Largest defense investment in Republic history ($3B). TAYFUN Block-4 hypersonic entering mass production. Air-launched ballistic missile tests planned 2026. Defense spending $27.34B. Probability 6%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: CFR warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 - Tier II risk. India summoned Iran ambassador after Indian vessel attacked in Hormuz. India rejected US mediation claims. PM Sharif in Qatar mediating. Hormuz closure threatens India energy imports. Probability 7%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 72. RISING: Finland parliament vote on nuclear weapons hosting expected. First of 64 F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: deployment poses threat, will force countermeasures. Finnish professor warns Finland could be first target in NATO-Russia war. Denmark intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months. Russia reinforcing nuclear/Arctic assets. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Prob 31%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: RISING: US intelligence indicates China preparing weapons shipment to Iran - air defense systems, advanced radar, shoulder-fired missiles. CBS: China weighing supplying Iran advanced radar. NYT details decades of Chinese weapons transfers to Iran. China says military activities around Taiwan reasonable and justified. ISW/AEI: PRC infiltration into Taiwan documented. Taiwan opposition parties blocking defense procurement. Xi met KMT Cheng Li-wun. Philippines opened coast guard base on Thitu Island. China mediating Pakistan-Afghanistan talks. US redeploying from Pacific to Middle East benefits China. Probability 42%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 68. RISING: Launched multiple ballistic missiles toward sea Apr 18 from Sinpo area - 7th test of 2026. Japan strongly protested. Kim oversaw 3-day weapons test series Apr 6-8 including cluster-bomb warheads, 5-missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer, ICBM engine test. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. ODNI confirms full US mainland ICBM range. Polymarket tracking missile test by Apr 30. Probability 12%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1173+. RISING: Russia launched one of LARGEST attacks of 2026 - 659 drones + 44 missiles, 16+ killed, 118+ wounded. Ukraine devastating Russian oil infrastructure - 40% of export capacity disabled. Baltic ports Primorsk (40% storage lost), Ust-Luga (30%), Novorossiysk hit, Crimea Feodosia destroyed. Ukraine launched 7,000+ long-range drones in March. Germany commits EUR300M + 5,000 drones. Russia threatens European industries funding Ukrainian drones. Polymarket ceasefire by Apr 30: 0.4%. Probability 33%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: "Open war" continues - Pakistan bombed major cities including Kabul. China-mediated Urumqi 2nd round concluded - agreed not to escalate but fighting continues. Border clashes ongoing. Pakistani Taliban announced 3-day ceasefire for Eid. Pakistan operations against Taliban to continue despite peace talks. CSIS: crisis drifting from resolution. Probability 5%. Stable.
